definitions.explanation: Used with negative expressions to mean not doing something properly or adequately.

examples.japanese: {碌|ろく}に⟦{食|た}べていない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{碌|ろく}に⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
{碌|ろく}に⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He left without even explaining properly.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{碌|ろく}に is almost always used with NEGATIVE forms:
- {碌|ろく}に〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (doesn't do properly)
- {碌|ろく}に〜⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (can't do properly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {碌|ろく}に⟦{食|た}べていない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: haven't eaten properly
- {碌|ろく}に⟦{寝|ね}ていない→寝る：00470_neru⟧: haven't slept properly
- {碌|ろく}に⟦{話|はな}せない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: can't speak properly
- {碌|ろく}に⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧: don't really know

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as ろくに.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: don't do properly
- ⟦まともに→まとも：10507_matomo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: don't do decently
